checks.title: Stroke weights
consider: Horizontal parts (40.0) are as heavy as vertical ones (40.0). Horizontals look heavier than verticals of the same width; type designers often draw them 5 to 10% lighter. Optional for a geometric monoline mark.

checks.title: Circles and curves

checks.title: Angles

checks.title: Small sizes
checks.summary: Gaps fill in below about 21 px tall, so the 16 to 32 px favicon sizes blur
consider: Gaps fill in below about 21 px tall, so the 16 to 32 px favicon sizes blur. For favicons and small avatars, consider a simplified version with fewer, wider gaps.

checks.title: Colour on backgrounds
checks.summary: weak on mid grey, dark grey, near-black
consider: #1d5e74 is weak on dark grey, near-black. For dark backgrounds, a lighter version with the same hue, #65a3bb, gives dark grey 4.6:1, near-black 6.9:1. Use it only with the owner's agreement; the one-colour white or black version is the other option.
On mid tones (mid grey) no version of the colour is strong. Use the one-colour white or black version there, or keep the logo off mid-tone and busy photo areas.

checks.summary: readable with common colour vision deficiencies
